title: parse_sse_block is pub-exported but is an internal implementation detail
description: lib.rs exports parse_sse_block as a public API item: 'pub use sse::{parse_sse_block, SseEvent, SseFrame}'. parse_sse_block takes a raw SSE block string — a format detail of the internal stream parser. Callers typically consume SseFrame from the subscribe_events stream and never need to call parse_sse_block directly. Exporting it exposes implementation detail, widens the semver surface, and may confuse callers about the intended usage. Consider making it pub(crate) unless there is a documented use case for callers to parse SSE blocks independently.
